title: Wave motifs

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Use decorative division only where it supports the message so brand recognition does not compete with content.
strategic_value: A familiar wave behind a title or logo can identify Helsinki while leaving the message prominent.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture pairs guidance on wave use in videos with a blue field divided by a repeated wave edge.
practical_value: Consider a wave behind the opening frame or logo, and omit it when it interferes with content.

content_islands.name: Wave guidance
content_islands.spec: Place permission and the warning against overuse above the example.

content_islands.name: Divided blue field
content_islands.spec: Show two blue areas joined by the wave edge as a static video-layout example.

ingredient.name: Video wave motif
ingredient.role: Add a recognizable division behind a message.
ingredient.application: Use the approved wave in a logo-screen or opening-frame background without overuse.
ingredient.scope: Video and animation; this capture does not demonstrate movement or timing.

reference_purposes.Application: The text permits waves behind the framed logo or opening frame.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Waves must follow the identity guidelines and should not interfere with content.
reference_purposes.Expression: The static specimen demonstrates a repeated wave separating blue fields.
